optimizedDescription.value: Privacy decorator hashes, masks, or anonymizes identity while excluded actors remain verbatim.

optimizedContext.value:
# Actor Resolver Privacy
## Rules
- Modes: hash HMAC SHA-256 email with secret salt, deterministic; mask; anonymous static Anonymous.
- Mask name first char plus stars, one-char name stars. Local email first/last plus stars, one-char repeats, <=2 fully mask. Domain first char plus TLD; drop subdomains.
- Active privacy removes providerId and non-whitelisted metadata.
- excludeActors matches name/email case-insensitively; return raw identity, providerId, metadata verbatim; exclusion wins.
## Constraints
- Same email/salt creates same hash.
